$comment: Coach's notebook strings (O6.6.1; E11, E10.4.1). Every user-facing string comes from here by id with named slots. Commitment wording defaults are the catalogue's text keys (career coach/philosophy.ts); the coach may reword them (E10.1.1 rule 1).

strings.nb.title: Notebook
strings.nb.blank: Your notebook is empty. Press N on any screen to write a note about what you are looking at.
strings.nb.filter.subject: About
strings.nb.write.label: New note
strings.nb.edit.label: Note text
strings.nb.error.note.too_long: That note is longer than 4,000 characters. Split it into two notes.
strings.nb.error.note.merge_needs_two: Select two or more notes to merge.
strings.nb.prompt.season_end: at the end of each season
strings.nb.ledger.boss: {name}: words and decisions, as the staff sees them
strings.nb.ledger.draft: Private draft. Nothing is measured against it until you have a team, and you can present it in an interview.
strings.nb.ledger.statement.boss: In the head coach's own words
strings.nb.ledger.none: No commitments made. A coach who says nothing is measured against nothing; people still judge what he does.
strings.nb.ledger.window: Kept {share} of the time over the last {seasons} seasons
strings.nb.behaviour.kept_every_time: Kept it every time it was tested.
strings.nb.behaviour.broke_every_time: Broke it every time it was tested.
strings.nb.behaviour.kept_and_broke: Kept it {kept} times and broke it {broke} times.
strings.nb.measure.depth_change: At each depth chart change: was the promoted player's recent film grade at least the demoted player's?
strings.nb.measure.discipline_case: Each discipline case, compared with like cases for other players.
strings.nb.measure.fourth_down: Fourth downs where the model rated going clearly better: did he go?
strings.nb.measure.two_point: Tries where the model rated going for two clearly better: did he go?
strings.nb.measure.young_snaps: Each game: did young players get their share of snaps?
strings.nb.measure.game_penalties: Each game: penalty yards against the limit.
strings.nb.measure.late_game_calls: Leading late in games: was the run share kept up?
strings.nb.measure.roster_notice: Each roster move: was the player told first?
strings.nb.measure.injury_return: Each return from injury: did anyone play before the doctors cleared them?
strings.commitment.rules_same_for_everyone: The rules are the same for everyone.
strings.commitment.go_when_numbers_say_go: We go on fourth down when the numbers say go.
strings.commitment.go_for_two_when_numbers_say: We go for two when the numbers say so.
strings.commitment.run_to_win_fourth_quarter: We run the ball to win in the fourth quarter.
strings.commitment.tell_you_first: You will hear it from me first.
strings.commitment.no_beating_ourselves: We will not beat ourselves with penalties.
